en.headline: Red flags raised at Stanley and Clear Water Bay beaches over big waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department advised the public not to swim at Stanley Main Beach and Clear Water Bay Second Beach after red flags were hoisted on Friday afternoon.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department hoisted red flags at Stanley Main Beach on Hong Kong Island and Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung on Friday afternoon due to big waves.
Beachgoers were advised not to enter the water at the two beaches. The announcement was issued at 2.32pm.
Red flags indicate that swimming is dangerous because of rough sea conditions. Other beaches remained open subject to local conditions and any separate warnings.

zh.headline: 赤柱及清水灣二灘因湧浪掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署周五下午因湧浪在赤柱正灘及清水灣第二灣泳灘掛上紅旗，呼籲泳客勿下水。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周五下午因湧浪在港島赤柱正灘及西貢清水灣第二灣泳灘掛上紅旗。
署方呼籲泳客不要在這兩個泳灘下水，公告於下午2時32分發出。
紅旗代表海況惡劣，游泳危險。其他泳灘仍按當地情況及任何獨立警告開放。
